Following the fall of the [[Eternal Empire]], the [[Eternal Alliance]] rose in its place as the superior faction in the galaxy, facing many '''uprisings''' against its authority. With the support of the [[Eternal Alliance Recon Unit]], the Alliance's [[Alliance Commander|leader]] was able to defeat all uprisings and maintain its power base in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
